mainEntity.name: What is the Toshi Bet VIP Club?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Toshi Bet VIP Club is a loyalty program that rewards players with exclusive bonuses, rakeback, reload bonuses, and dedicated VIP host services as they progress through 15 tiers from Bronze to Obsidian.

mainEntity.name: How do I join the Toshi Bet VIP Club?

acceptedAnswer.text: You automatically enter the VIP Club program once you reach $10,000 in total wager. Your progress is tracked and you move up tiers as you continue wagering.

mainEntity.name: What are the VIP tiers at Toshi Bet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Toshi Bet has 15 VIP tiers: Bronze ($10K wager), Silver ($50K), Gold ($100K), Platinum I–VI ($250K–$10M), Diamond I–V ($25M–$500M), and Obsidian ($1B). Each tier unlocks more bonuses, higher rakeback, and better benefits.

mainEntity.name: What is rakeback at Toshi Bet VIP Club?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rakeback is a percentage of your wagered amount returned to you as a bonus. All VIP Club members from Bronze level onwards receive rakeback, with higher tiers receiving a greater percentage back.

mainEntity.name: What bonuses do VIP members receive?

acceptedAnswer.text: VIP members receive weekly bonuses, monthly bonuses, level-up bonuses, reload bonuses (daily for Platinum+), and dedicated VIP host bonuses for Platinum IV and above tiers.

mainEntity.name: Do VIP members get a personal account manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Players who reach Platinum IV level ($2,500,000 total wager) and above are assigned a dedicated VIP host who provides personalized bonuses and support.
